_comment: Model fit cases read from a project's saved state (read-only; nothing is run). A case is final only when the decision has a judged results file; a run that stopped early (e.g. Gemini's daily quota) is pending, with its provisional verdict from the journal. Re-run `notbydefault eval --sections fit` after the check finishes to fill it in.

cases.needs: the Gemini judge (gemini:gemini-3.8-flash); its free quota resets at midnight Pacific (12:30 IST)
